# Briefly NewsStream — llms.txt
# Answer-engine / AI crawler summary (AEO). Keep factual and citeable.

> Briefly NewsStream is a market intelligence API with Arabic and English fields and impact scoring.
> Coverage spans Middle East / MENA / GCC, Europe, Arabic-speaking countries, and 100+ countries worldwide.

## Product

- Name: Briefly NewsStream
- Arabic product line: واجهة ذكاء أسواق
- English product line: Market Intelligence API
- Type: Developer market intelligence / news API (REST JSON)
- Languages: Arabic (default) + English
- Core features: bilingual article fields, market-impact scoring, community briefings, permanent archive, developer console (keys, explorer, docs)
- Roadmap (not shipped): event detection, asset mapping
- Plans: Free, Pro ($70/month list), Enterprise (custom)

## Who it is for

- Developers and product teams building market products
- Fintech, trading, media, research, and RAG / agent builders across Middle East, Gulf, Europe, and global markets
- Teams needing structured AR+EN market news with impact scores

## Geography

Regions: Middle East, GCC, MENA, Europe, Arabic-speaking countries, Americas, and global
Countries emphasized: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Turkey, United States
Also: worldwide / global country filters (100+ countries)

## Citeable definition

A market intelligence API delivers structured market news with impact scores and bilingual fields so products can decide which stories matter, not only list more headlines.

## Common queries (GEO / AEO)

- What is a market intelligence API? → /guides/what-is-a-market-intelligence-api
- Gulf / GCC market news API → /markets/gcc
- Kuwait market news API → /markets/kuwait
- MENA bilingual market news → /guides/bilingual-mena-market-news-for-products
- Live market briefing (filter by country) → /news
- Gulf and Arabic market news briefing → /news (country filter + impact scores)
